correctness.rationale: The unique directed rotor cycle containing the chip characterizes recurrence by Holroyd et al. The four-row excursion table is directly checkable. Before the last bad petal, its untouched internal 2-cycle excludes a unicycle; at first arrival there it becomes the unique cycle containing the chip. This gives tau=6J-2B+1 for every k>=1. Counting good/bad prefixes derives H_k and max shell. Differentiation gives mean; total defects Bin(k,1/4) and tight trailing good run yield the Gaussian limit. Two independently structured trajectory detectors exhaustively match the prediction on all 21,844 states with k<=7; finite tests are corroboration, not proof.

value.rationale: Exact first-entrance-time distribution on a natural non-tree graph distinguishes the rare worst-case state population (3/4)^(k-1)/4 from typical O(k) settling with central-limit fluctuations. This provides a model-specific structural last-defect reduction and sharp finite-size distribution not afforded by known general recurrence criteria. Its conditional initialization and graph family are natural for studying an intermediate cactus topology, with a fully explicit probabilistic consequence.
